title: Integrated testing coordinator: qualifications and evidence for integrated fire and life-safety systems testing
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: March 2025 (platform created March 11, 2025, last updated March 11, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies the expectation for qualifications of an integrated testing coordinator.
CAN/ULC-S1001 requires an integrated testing coordinator who is knowledgeable and experienced in the design, installation and operation of the fire protection and life safety systems.

Before construction begins, the owner must submit evidence to the authority having jurisdiction that a registered professional has been retained to design the system and to field review and witness its testing.
